'''Guids''' were large, hair-covered [[Primate/Legends|primates]] native to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The guid's massive frame was supported by their muscular arms and smaller hind legs, supporting their weight on their knuckles as they walked. Dominating the mountainsides of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] as they grazed on the grassy open spaces, the guid's only natural predator were the primitive [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] known as [[Flesh Raider]]s. All other predators on the planet, including the [[Manka cat/Legends|manka cat]] and [[horranth]], were not intelligent enough to pose a threat to the massive beasts and their strong arms. In [[3640 BBY]] guids could also be found on the ice planet [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> an ill-tempered guid in the [[Tythos River Delta]] was driven mad by an unknown [[Disease/Legends|ailment]] and came to pose a threat to others, including its own kind. Members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] then put it down for everyones safety.<ref name="IllTempered">{{TORcite|type=dynamic|Ill-Tempered Guid|[[Tython/Legends|Tython]]}}</ref>
